name: Gremlins: Secrets of the Mogwai
description: Set in 1920s Shanghai, ten-year-old Sam and 12-year-old Elle return the Mogwai Gizmo back home to the lush and perilous Valley of Jade.

videos.title: Never Get Them Wet
videos.overview: As Gizmo is torn from his home and captured by a miserable circus, sheltered ten-year-old Sam Wing’s retired treasure-hunting grandpa introduces him to a whole new world of magic.

videos.title: Never Feed Them After Midnight
videos.overview: With Gizmo's newest batch on the loose, Sam is torn between his promise of keeping the Mogwai safe or returning to his normal life a choice that is complicated further by an alliance with street thief Elle.

videos.title: Always Buy a Ticket
videos.overview: All aboard! The trust between Sam, Elle, and Gizmo is tested by a hungry supernatural stranger on a train.

videos.title: Don't Drink the Tea
videos.overview: When a raging storm forces her, Sam, and Gizmo to seek shelter, Elle struggles to hide her past from her friends and a too-friendly innkeeper.

videos.title: Always Stab or Run
videos.overview: Sam, Elle, and Gizmo's nerves are tested as they follow Grandpa's map through the scariest woods they've ever encountered where more than soul-sucking, undead bureaucrats lurk in the darkness.

videos.title: Always Buy a God a Drink First
videos.overview: Upon arriving at the vibrant and bizarre Spirit Market, Sam and Elle must convince Gizmo's maker that not all humans are bad an argument complicated by Riley Greene's hot pursuit.

videos.title: Never Squeeze a Fox
videos.overview: It's a race against the clock as Sam, Elle, and Gizmo battle fearsome yet adorable monsters on their way to the Valley of Jade as long as Greene and the Gremlins don't catch up with them first!

videos.title: Never Hug a Mogwai
videos.overview: The friends celebrate their arrival at the Valley of Jade, but will Sam finally gain the confidence he desperately needs?

videos.title: Never Give Up
videos.overview: Devastated by failure, Sam and Elle must look inward to find the strength to protect Shanghai from being overrun with violent Gremlins.

videos.title: Never Ever Expose Them to Bright Light
videos.overview: With our heroes reunited, their bond is put to a final test as enemies from all sides converge.

videos.title: Always be Ready for Adventure
videos.overview: The Wing family is back in adventure mode after Sam discovers new evidence of Mogwai related problems, and Gizmo starts to act ... different.

videos.title: Never Take the Tour
videos.overview: Magic has dropped our heroes short of their San Francisco destination, so now they must escape a notorious prison and its unusual guards.

videos.title: Never Use Double Negatives
videos.overview: Upon reaching San Francisco's Chinatown, our heroes discover its criminal underworld has been taken over by an old acquaintance.

videos.title: Always Bring a Toothpick
videos.overview: Sam and Chang recruit help to rescue Gizmo from Noggin's Evil Mogwai gang. Elle discovers that her mother is alive but facing her own magical problem.

videos.title: There's Always a Fortune in the Cookie Factory
videos.overview: It's the battle for Chinatown! But will Chang and Chinatown's residents ultimately choose to side with our heroes?

videos.title: Never Get Out of the Truck
videos.overview: Our heroes journey west to free Elle's mother, but first must free themselves from a haunted old mansion.

videos.title: Always Ask for Backstory
videos.overview: Still on their western quest, our heroes are recruited to help a town with their own supernatural problem: nightly hauntings by a legendary ghost!

videos.title: Never Try the Cider
videos.overview: To reach their destination, our heroes pass through the resting place for all of the west's wildest tall tales and legends.

videos.title: Always or Never Make Wishes
videos.overview: As they make a treacherous journey into a mysterious desert tomb, Sam and Elle must choose between saving Elle's mother or heeding Grandpa's warning.

videos.title: Always Make the Hard Choice
videos.overview: Our heroes must find a way to reunite if they want any hope of defeating a massive, monstrous force before it destroys America.
